description: [Approved mode — write] This tool creates a new app in the Pushizo organization. It needs an organization-wide API key with the `mcp:write` scope whose creator may create apps (owner/admin), or the `admin` scope. Get explicit approval from the user before calling it. Records the same setup state as the dashboard wizard (platforms and framework), so the user can continue in the dashboard. Next steps: get_setup_status, get_sdk_snippet, then upload the push credentials (local server: upload_channel_credentials; otherwise the dashboard link from get_setup_status).
name: create_app
title: Create app
